segments.subtask: The robot arm moves towards the green mat with the food and utensils.
The robot arm grasps the food item with the right gripper.
The robot arm moves the food item towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the food item into the right basket.
The robot arm moves towards the green mat with the non-food items.
The robot arm grasps the non-food item with the left gripper.
The robot arm moves the non-food item towards the left basket.
The robot arm places the non-food item into the left basket.
